u3: The agent is carrying the box again after a fall. Continue toward the exit holding the box, and be ready to pick it up immediately if it falls once more.
u4: An absorbing state in which no relevant condition ever held; the episode has ended without reaching the exit. Nothing more to do.
u5: The agent reached the exit without the box in its hands, ending the episode with zero reward. Terminal state; the task was failed.
u6: The agent reached the exit while holding the box, satisfying the objective. Terminal success state; the task is complete.
